data.title: Fast Notes Privacy Policy
data.body:
*Effective November 9, 2026* Fast Notes turns a chat message, a photo of a notice or something you say into events, reminders, notes and contacts. The app is provided by Cross Tech & Edu ("we"). This policy explains how the app handles your data. [Đọc chính sách này bằng tiếng Việt](/projects/fast-notes/chinh-sach-bao-mat/)
## Summary All analysis runs on your phone. Fast Notes has no accounts, no servers of its own, no ads, no analytics or tracking, and does not sell data. We never receive the content you enter. ## Data processed on your device | Data | Purpose | Where it stays | | --- | --- | --- | | Text you paste, type or dictate | Extract events, reminders, notes and phone numbers | In-app history, on your device | | Photos you take or choose | Read the text with on-device text recognition | Photos are not stored, only the recognised text | | Trial start date, subscription status | Count the 3-month free trial | Keychain (iOS) / encrypted storage (Android) | | Default calendar, alert time | Remember your settings | On your device | AI analysis uses the model built into the operating system and runs on the device: Apple Intelligence (Foundation Models) on iPhone and Gemini Nano through AICore on Android. On devices without on-device AI, the app uses its built-in parser, which also runs on the device. ## Permissions The app asks for a permission only when you use the matching feature: - **Calendar and Reminders:** to add the items you reviewed and confirmed. The app lists your calendars so you can pick a default; it does not read your existing events. - **Contacts:** to write new contacts you confirmed. The app does not read your contacts. - **Camera and Photos:** to take or choose a photo whose text you want read. - **Microphone and Speech Recognition:** to turn your speech into text. The app prefers on-device recognition. If your device has no offline speech model for your language, the system speech service (Apple or Google) may process the audio under its own privacy policy. Items added to Calendar, Reminders or Contacts sync according to your account settings (for example iCloud or Google) and are no longer managed by Fast Notes. ## Payments Subscriptions are processed by the Apple App Store or Google Play. We never receive your card or payment account details; the app only receives the transaction result to unlock Premium. ## Your choices and deleting data - You can turn off any permission in your device settings at any time. - In the app, open **Settings → Clear history** to delete everything stored. - Uninstalling the app deletes its data. On iPhone the trial start date may remain in the Keychain so the free trial cannot be restarted. ## Children The app is not directed to children under 13. ## Changes If we change this policy, we will update this page and its effective date. ## Contact Cross Tech & Edu · [support@crosstechedu.com](mailto:support@crosstechedu.com)
